overview_description.description:
1Trolley is an end to end solution that empowers retailers by digitising their last mile and helping them transition to online ordering.

We digitise neighbourhoods and malls enabling retailers to compete in a digitised world while meeting increased consumer demand for immediate delivery.

Empowering communities through digital transformation.
